evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 437.2 °C, markedly inconsistent with the other column temperatures of 63.4–70.0 °C.
T701 remains exceptionally high at 441.5 °C while all other installed temperature channels read 63.3–73.6 °C; actual overheating versus a temperature measurement fault is unresolved.
System pressure is 499.7 mbar, pressure differences are 0.7 and 3.1 mbar, and both level switches remain 1; these channels show no corresponding major excursion.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and scaling checks, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish overheating from a measurement fault. No composition measurement or target specification is provided. Reflux and distillate flow instruments are not installed, so the operating flow ratio cannot be verified from these observations.
